prompt:
Hi, I need your help with two things related to our outgoing email system.

First, I need to send our Q4 regulatory compliance notification right away:
- From: compliance@fincorp.com
- To: regulators@finra.org
- Subject: Q4 2024 Regulatory Compliance Notification
- Body: Please find attached our Q4 2024 compliance report. All regulatory requirements have been met. Contact compliance@fincorp.com for queries.
- BCC to both: legal@fincorp.com and audit@fincorp.com

Second, I just noticed someone accidentally queued an email with the subject 'TEST - ignore this' — that needs to be pulled from the outgoing queue before it reaches anyone. The 'Monthly Ops Review' email that's also in there should stay.

Please handle both of these.
